proposals.why: Makeshift shelters of sticks and plastic at a transit camp near Nyala, South Darfur (c. 2005, US-government work): the shelter need the story is about. Older photo; owner should check no person is in distress

proposals.author: Sudan Envoy
proposals.credit: Photo: Sudan Envoy / Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0
proposals.why: A path through an IDP camp in El Geneina, West Darfur (2009, US Special Envoy to Sudan); Flickr review passed. Only 1024 px wide: fallback

stories.note: Few recent, large, freely licensed Sudan shelter photos exist on Commons. Rejected: 'Tawila refugees setting up shelter.jpg' (2025, 1170 px; labelled CC BY-SA 2.0 but credit reads '© UNOCHA' from UN News, no licence review: licence doubtful); 2024 Arabic-titled displacement photos (identifiable people in distress). A better option could be searched on the UNHCR/IOM Flickr only if the licence there is CC BY (most are NC/ND).

stories.note: No photo of the 2026 winners (Siyum Manazot Taferi, Yatane Kormoshe Dusha) exists on Wikimedia Commons: searched Commons for the race, both names and Category:Athens Classic Marathon (newest files from 2013). Old race photos with runners left out on the owner's instruction (never runners from a different year). Not proposed: 'The Runner' glass sculpture by Kostas Varotsos (only 1600 px; modern artwork by a living artist and Greece has limited freedom of panorama, so copyright doubtful).
